text_block_list.text: Whoa! How many did you get?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Check them out. What's your appraisal?

text_block_list.text:
No doubt they're cute. The facial
expressions are
captured well too, I
guess.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But probably the best thing I learned
today is
that you're pretty good at
games.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
So, this is just hypothetically speaking,
but...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Next time you come here, if they happen
to have
a new version of me, you need
to get it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I'll do my best so they'll have to make a Cutie of me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
